name: verifact

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @verifact/core && npm run build -w @verifact/react
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:studio && npm run build -w @verifact/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @verifact/core && npm run test -w @verifact/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @verifact/core && npm run typecheck -w @verifact/cli
scripts.ci: npm run build:packages && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke

description: Verify AI-generated claims against the exact bytes of their sources, block hallucinations, and issue signed evidence certificates anyone can check offline.
